fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on an alleged police beating of Charles Haynes and the city commissioners' investigation, with discussion of grand jury action and civic accountability. Coverage also addresses local politics and upcoming elections ("Political Peeps" and a call for candidates to submit platforms for a forthcoming political issue), criticism of restrictive policies at the new Miami High School, and debate over a city resolution favoring American-made cement and its implications for foreign trade and port development. Additional items include notes on aviation enforcement over Miami Beach, discussion of airport location at Gratigny and alternatives such as Biscayne Bay, Community Chest fundraising, and local civic and social news with advertisements.
